title: Artists Painting Airplanes
content: Artists were painting airplanes this weekend at the Old Rhinebeck Aerodrome.New video on YouTubeI dropped by to visit theAmerican Society of Aviation Artistswho were set up at the aerodrome for a plein-air painting session around a World War 1 biplane.I used watercolor and gouache to sketch Don Meadows, one of the ASAA members. He was standing at his easel with a Fokker D VII behind.Old Rhinebeck AerodromeRussell SmithMarc Poole
